question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a pink present, Bob has a grey present, Claire has a brown present, Dave has a red present, Eve has a white present, Fred has a silver present, and Gertrude has a orange present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) pink present
(B) grey present
(C) brown present
(D) red present
(E) white present
(F) silver present
(G) orange present
solution:
Each row lists present colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: pink, grey, brown, red, white, silver, orange
1. Dave ↔ Claire: pink, grey, red, brown, white, silver, orange
2. Claire ↔ Eve: pink, grey, white, brown, red, silver, orange
3. Fred ↔ Alice: silver, grey, white, brown, red, pink, orange
4. Claire ↔ Dave: silver, grey, brown, white, red, pink, orange
5. Claire ↔ Bob: silver, brown, grey, white, red, pink, orange
6. Claire ↔ Dave: silver, brown, white, grey, red, pink, orange
7. Eve ↔ Fred: silver, brown, white, grey, pink, red, orange
Alice has the silver present, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
